soil.notes: The closest thing to a full sand race in the US, but over a deceptively hard base - not as deep as Lommel. Crews add sand for depth.

layout.notes: Bumps are more square-edged than European sand. Local sand riders often run well here.

conditions.dry: Ruts and bumps form quickly; very physical.
conditions.wet: Sand takes light rain well; heavy rain can wash added sand away. Rain the week before leaves a slippery base that causes wheelspin.
conditions.late_day: Gets slower through the day, not faster; second qualifying slower than first; class that runs last gets the roughest track.
conditions.seasonal: Pro national late June / early July; 50 years of pro racing in 2026. Hot, humid, with possible afternoon storms.

rider_reports.says: Analyst: sand over a hard base with square-edged bumps; ride the berm sweet spot - too low spins, too deep buries the rear; stay light on entry, then commit to throttle.
Analyst: after a wet week the base was slippery and riders dug through it with wheelspin; track slowed through the afternoon; late-moto fitness made the difference.
Preview: deep sand where ruts form fast and line choice keeps changing; conditioning matters most.
